title: 超解析螢光顯微鏡~Super-resolution fluorescence microscopy
focus: SIM 頻率混合、STED 損耗飽和、單分子定位精度、標記密度與奈奎斯特、漂移校正與解析度預算~SIM frequency mixing, STED depletion saturation, single-molecule localization precision, labeling density and Nyquist, drift correction and resolution budgets
summary: 從 Abbe 繞射極限出發，理解結構照明、STED 與單分子定位如何利用頻率混合與螢光開關繞過它，再把損耗飽和、染料佔空比與標記密度、TIRF 背景與相機雜訊、漂移與焦距鎖定、解析度預算與 FRC、技術選擇與標準樣品驗收整合成可交接的超解析系統工程。~Start from the Abbe diffraction limit to see how structured illumination, STED and single-molecule localization bypass it with frequency mixing and fluorescence switching, then integrate depletion saturation, dye duty cycle and labeling density, TIRF background and camera noise, drift and focus lock, resolution budgets and FRC, technique choice and reference-sample acceptance into a transferable super-resolution system record.

units.anchor: 繞射極限與螢光開關~Diffraction limit and fluorescence switching
units.title: 繞射極限與三種繞過策略~The diffraction limit and three ways around it
units.mechanism: 傳統螢光顯微鏡的光學轉移函數在空間頻率 2NA/λ 截止，比 λ/(2NA) 更細的結構傳不到相機。超解析方法不是打破繞射，而是繞過它：結構照明（SIM）以已知條紋與樣品頻率混合，把截止外的資訊以摩爾紋搬進通帶，解析度約提升 2 倍；STED 以損耗光強迫焦點周圍的分子回到暗態，只留下中心的奈米發光區；單分子定位（PALM/STORM）讓分子在時間上輪流亮起，每次只有稀疏的分子發光，再以擬合求中心，精度約 s/√N。三者分別以線性光學、確定性切換與隨機切換換取解析度，速度、光劑量與標記要求各不相同。~The optical transfer function of a conventional fluorescence microscope cuts off at spatial frequency 2NA/λ, so structure finer than λ/(2NA) never reaches the camera. Super-resolution methods do not break diffraction but go around it: structured illumination (SIM) mixes a known fringe pattern with sample frequencies, moving information beyond the cutoff into the passband as moiré and gaining about a factor of 2; STED uses a depletion beam to force molecules around the focus back to a dark state, leaving a nanoscale emitting centre; single-molecule localization (PALM/STORM) lets molecules light up in turn so only sparse emitters glow at once, then fits their centres with precision near s/√N. The three trade linear optics, deterministic switching and stochastic switching for resolution, at different costs in speed, dose and labeling.
units.model: λ = 520 nm、NA = 1.4：Abbe 極限 λ/(2NA) ≈ 186 nm，截止頻率 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹。SIM 以 488 nm 激發條紋最高 5.74 µm⁻¹，延伸支援 5.38 + 5.74 = 11.1 µm⁻¹，約 90 nm。110 nm 週期結構（9.09 µm⁻¹）與 200 nm 條紋（5.0 µm⁻¹）混頻成 4.09 µm⁻¹、週期 244 nm 的摩爾紋，落在通帶內。定位：PSF 標準差 s ≈ 94 nm、N = 1000 光子時理想精度 s/√N ≈ 3.0 nm。~At λ = 520 nm and NA = 1.4 the Abbe limit λ/(2NA) is ≈ 186 nm and the cutoff 2NA/λ ≈ 5.38 µm⁻¹. SIM with 488 nm excitation fringes reaches at most 5.74 µm⁻¹, extending support to 5.38 + 5.74 = 11.1 µm⁻¹, about 90 nm. A 110 nm period structure (9.09 µm⁻¹) mixed with 200 nm fringes (5.0 µm⁻¹) yields 4.09 µm⁻¹ moiré of 244 nm period, inside the passband. For localization, a PSF standard deviation s ≈ 94 nm and N = 1000 photons give an ideal precision s/√N ≈ 3.0 nm.
units.verify: 以 100 nm 以下的螢光珠在寬場模式量 PSF 並求 OTF 截止頻率，確認接近 2NA/λ；同一樣品以 SIM 重建後在傅立葉譜上確認支援範圍擴大到約兩倍；在固定的稀疏單分子樣品上重複定位同一分子 100 次，量位置標準差並與 s/√N 比較。~Measure the PSF of sub-100 nm beads in widefield and derive the OTF cutoff, confirming it is near 2NA/λ; reconstruct the same sample with SIM and confirm in the Fourier spectrum that support has roughly doubled; on a fixed sparse single-molecule sample localize one molecule 100 times, measure the positional standard deviation and compare with s/√N.
units.failure: 把 SIM 重建影像上的細紋當成超解析結構，實際上是條紋頻率或相位估計錯誤造成的蜂巢狀或條紋狀重建假影；研究者把假影解讀為新的蛋白排列，直到論文被質疑才發現。~Fine lines in a SIM reconstruction are taken as super-resolved structure when they are honeycomb or stripe artefacts from wrongly estimated fringe frequency or phase; researchers interpret the artefact as a new protein arrangement and discover the error only when the paper is challenged.
units.misconception: 超解析顯微鏡突破了繞射定律。~Super-resolution microscopes break the laws of diffraction.

units.anchor: 甜甜圈損耗光與飽和強度~Doughnut depletion beam and saturation
units.title: STED 損耗飽和與解析度定律~STED depletion saturation and the resolution law
units.mechanism: STED 在激發光點上疊加一束中心為零的甜甜圈形損耗光，波長位於螢光光譜紅端，以受激發射把激發態分子在發出螢光前帶回基態。損耗效果隨強度飽和：局部強度遠大於飽和強度 I_sat 時幾乎所有分子都被關掉，只剩甜甜圈零點附近的分子能發光，有效光點依 d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) 縮小，原理上沒有下限。實務限制來自三處：零點品質（中心殘餘強度會壓低訊號）、損耗光造成的漂白與熱，以及激發與損耗光束在三維中的重合精度。~STED overlays the excitation spot with a doughnut-shaped depletion beam whose centre is zero, at a wavelength on the red edge of the emission spectrum, returning excited molecules to the ground state by stimulated emission before they fluoresce. Depletion saturates with intensity: where local intensity far exceeds the saturation intensity I_sat nearly every molecule is switched off and only those near the doughnut zero can emit, so the effective spot shrinks as d ≈ λ/(2NA·√(1 + I/I_sat)) with no lower bound in principle. Practical limits come from three places: the quality of the zero, since residual intensity there suppresses signal; bleaching and heating by the depletion light; and the three-dimensional overlap accuracy of the excitation and depletion beams.
units.model: λ = 640 nm、NA = 1.4：d₀ = 229 nm。要 40 nm 需 √(1 + I/I_sat) = 5.71，I/I_sat ≈ 31.7；I/I_sat = 10 只有 69 nm，100 可到 23 nm。零點品質以 η = 1/(1 + I/I_sat) 近似：甜甜圈中心殘留峰值 1% 的強度時中心 I/I_sat ≈ 0.32，訊號只剩 76%；殘留 3% 時剩 51%，解析度不變但訊號減半。~At λ = 640 nm and NA = 1.4, d₀ = 229 nm. Reaching 40 nm needs √(1 + I/I_sat) = 5.71, so I/I_sat ≈ 31.7; I/I_sat = 10 gives only 69 nm and 100 reaches 23 nm. Approximating zero quality with η = 1/(1 + I/I_sat): a residual of 1% of peak at the doughnut centre gives I/I_sat ≈ 0.32 there and only 76% of signal remains; a 3% residual leaves 51%, halving signal with no gain in resolution.
units.verify: 以 80 nm 金奈米粒子在反射模式掃描損耗光，直接量甜甜圈剖面與中心殘留百分比；以螢光珠或已知間距的 DNA 摺紙樣品在多個損耗功率下量有效光點 FWHM，擬合 d 對 √(1 + I/I_sat) 的關係求 I_sat；再量激發與損耗光束中心的三維偏移，確認小於數十奈米。~Scan the depletion beam over 80 nm gold nanoparticles in reflection to measure the doughnut profile and central residual directly; measure effective spot FWHM on beads or DNA origami of known spacing at several depletion powers and fit d against √(1 + I/I_sat) to obtain I_sat; then measure the 3D offset between excitation and depletion beam centres, confirming it is below a few tens of nanometres.
units.failure: 物鏡校正環設定錯誤造成球面像差，甜甜圈在深處失去乾淨的零點，中心殘留升到 5%，10 µm 深處亮度掉一半以上且解析度變差；操作者加大損耗功率企圖補救，反而讓漂白更快。~A wrong correction-collar setting introduces spherical aberration, the doughnut loses its clean zero at depth and the central residual climbs to 5%, so at 10 µm depth brightness drops by more than half and resolution worsens; the operator raises depletion power to compensate and only accelerates bleaching.
units.misconception: STED 解析度只由損耗光功率決定，功率越大越好。~STED resolution depends only on depletion power; more is always better.

units.anchor: 光開關染料與標記密度~Photoswitchable dyes and labeling density
units.title: 螢光團、閃爍緩衝液與標記密度~Fluorophores, blinking buffers and labeling density
units.mechanism: 單分子定位需要絕大多數分子處於暗態：光活化螢光蛋白（PALM）由紫光逐次打開，有機染料（dSTORM）則在含硫醇與除氧系統的緩衝液中進入長壽命暗態，再隨機回到亮態。每個分子亮著的時間比例稱為佔空比，它決定單位面積可容許的最大標記密度；奈奎斯特準則卻要求標記間距不大於目標解析度的一半，兩者互相拉扯。標記本身也有大小：一抗加二抗把螢光團放在離目標蛋白十幾奈米外，造成連結誤差，奈米抗體或自標記標籤等小型標記可大幅縮小它。~Single-molecule localization needs nearly all molecules dark: photoactivatable fluorescent proteins (PALM) are switched on a few at a time by violet light, while organic dyes (dSTORM) enter long-lived dark states in buffers with thiols and oxygen scavenging and return stochastically. The fraction of time a molecule spends on is its duty cycle, which sets the maximum labeling density per area; the Nyquist criterion, however, demands label spacing no larger than half the target resolution, so the two pull against each other. Labels also have size: primary plus secondary antibodies place the fluorophore over ten nanometres from the target protein, a linkage error that small labels such as nanobodies or self-labeling tags shrink greatly.
units.model: 目標解析度 20 nm 需標記間距 ≤ 10 nm，即 ≥ 1/(0.01 µm)² = 10⁴ 個/µm²。一個繞射面積約 (0.25 µm)² = 0.0625 µm² 內就有 625 個標記，要每幀至多一個亮著，佔空比必須 ≤ 1/625 = 1.6×10⁻³。若染料佔空比為 10⁻³（教學假設），每個標記在 M 幀內至少亮一次的機率為 1 − e^(−M/1000)，要 95% 覆蓋需 M ≈ 3000 幀。~A 20 nm target resolution needs label spacing ≤ 10 nm, that is ≥ 1/(0.01 µm)² = 10⁴ labels/µm². One diffraction area of about (0.25 µm)² = 0.0625 µm² then holds 625 labels, and keeping at most one on per frame needs a duty cycle ≤ 1/625 = 1.6×10⁻³. With a dye duty cycle of 10⁻³ (teaching assumption), the probability that a label lights at least once in M frames is 1 − e^(−M/1000), so 95% coverage needs M ≈ 3000 frames.
units.verify: 在稀疏標記樣品上統計每個分子的亮態與暗態時間，求佔空比與每次閃爍的光子數分布；在微管等密集結構上量相鄰定位重疊造成的誤合併率；以已知拷貝數的標準結構比較偵測到的分子數，估計標記效率。~On sparsely labelled samples measure on-state and off-state times per molecule to obtain the duty cycle and the photon-count distribution per blink; on dense structures such as microtubules measure the rate of false merges caused by overlapping neighbours; compare detected molecule counts with a standard structure of known copy number to estimate labeling efficiency.
units.failure: 緩衝液放置數小時後 pH 下降、除氧酵素失效，染料佔空比升高，每幀同時亮起的分子重疊，演算法把兩個分子擬合成位於中間的一個假定位，影像中出現沿結構中線的虛假細絲。~After several hours the buffer's pH drops and the oxygen-scavenging enzymes fail, the dye duty cycle rises, simultaneously active molecules overlap and the algorithm fits two molecules as one false localization midway between them, producing spurious filaments along structure midlines.
units.misconception: 標記越密越好，密度不會影響定位品質。~Denser labeling is always better and never harms localization.

units.anchor: TIRF 物鏡與單光子相機~TIRF objective and low-noise camera
units.title: 照明幾何、背景與偵測器選擇~Illumination geometry, background and detector choice
units.mechanism: 定位精度不只由光子數決定，背景與像素化同樣重要。全內反射（TIRF）照明以超過臨界角的入射在玻片表面形成漸逝波，只激發玻片上方約百奈米內的分子，大幅降低背景；斜照（HILO）則以略小於臨界角的傾斜光片照到細胞較深處。偵測器方面，EMCCD 以電子倍增壓過讀出雜訊，但倍增的隨機性帶來 √2 的過量雜訊因子，等效於光子數減半；sCMOS 讀出雜訊僅約 1 到 2 個電子，但每個像素的偏移與增益不同，必須逐像素校正。像素換算到樣品端約等於 PSF 標準差時精度最佳。~Localization precision depends not only on photon count but equally on background and pixelation. Total internal reflection (TIRF) illumination beyond the critical angle creates an evanescent wave at the coverslip that excites only molecules within about a hundred nanometres, sharply reducing background, while highly inclined illumination (HILO) uses a tilted sheet just below the critical angle to reach deeper into the cell. Among detectors, an EMCCD beats read noise by electron multiplication but its randomness adds an excess-noise factor of √2, equivalent to halving the photon count; an sCMOS has only 1 to 2 electrons of read noise but every pixel has its own offset and gain and must be calibrated individually. Precision is best when the pixel referred to the sample is about the PSF standard deviation.
units.model: 漸逝深度 d = λ/(4π√(n₁²sin²θ − n₂²))：λ = 640 nm、玻璃 n₁ = 1.518、細胞 n₂ = 1.37，臨界角 64.5°；θ = 68° 時 d ≈ 158 nm，θ = 65° 時 d ≈ 404 nm。Thompson 精度 σ² = (s² + a²/12)/N + 8πs⁴b²/(a²N²)，取 s = 94 nm、a = 100 nm、N = 1000：寬場背景 b = 10 時 σ ≈ 5.4 nm，TIRF 降到 b = 3 時 σ ≈ 3.4 nm，再乘 EMCCD 的 √2 得約 4.8 nm。~The evanescent depth is d = λ/(4π√(n₁²sin²θ − n₂²)): with λ = 640 nm, glass n₁ = 1.518 and cell n₂ = 1.37 the critical angle is 64.5°; θ = 68° gives d ≈ 158 nm and θ = 65° gives d ≈ 404 nm. Thompson precision σ² = (s² + a²/12)/N + 8πs⁴b²/(a²N²) with s = 94 nm, a = 100 nm and N = 1000 gives σ ≈ 5.4 nm for widefield background b = 10 and σ ≈ 3.4 nm for TIRF at b = 3, which the EMCCD √2 raises to about 4.8 nm.
units.verify: 以玻片上方不同高度的螢光珠量訊號對入射角的變化，確認臨界角位置與穿透深度；以暗場影像逐像素量 sCMOS 的偏移與變異數，以均勻照明量增益圖；在稀疏單分子樣品上比較實測定位精度（同一分子多次定位）與 Thompson 公式預測。~Measure signal versus incidence angle for beads at different heights above the coverslip to confirm the critical angle and penetration depth; measure sCMOS per-pixel offset and variance from dark frames and the gain map under uniform illumination; on a sparse single-molecule sample compare the measured precision from repeated localization of one molecule with the Thompson prediction.
units.failure: 入射角設在 65°，只比臨界角大 0.5°，室溫變化使載物台與物鏡輕微位移，入射角漂移跨越臨界角，穿透深度在 150 到 400 nm 間跳動，背景隨時間起伏，同一資料集前後的定位精度差 50%。~The incidence angle is set at 65°, only 0.5° above critical; room-temperature changes shift stage and objective slightly, the angle wanders across the critical angle, penetration depth jumps between 150 and 400 nm, background fluctuates and localization precision differs by 50% between the start and end of one dataset.
units.misconception: 只要光子夠多，背景高低不影響定位精度。~With enough photons, background does not affect localization precision.

units.anchor: 基準金粒子與焦距鎖定~Fiducial gold particles and focus lock
units.title: 漂移校正與焦距鎖定~Drift correction and focus lock
units.mechanism: 單分子定位要拍數千到數萬幀、耗時數分鐘，而載物台、物鏡與樣品座構成的結構迴路會隨溫度漂移數十奈米，遠大於定位精度。橫向漂移有兩種校正方式：在樣品中放入不會漂白的金奈米粒子或多色螢光珠作為基準點逐幀追蹤，或把定位資料切成時間段做影像互相關。軸向則以紅外光在玻片界面的反射建立主動焦距鎖定，否則失焦不只讓 PSF 變胖，3D 定位的高度也會整體偏移。STED 與 SIM 單張影像較快，但多色或長時間取像同樣需要漂移紀錄。~Single-molecule localization records thousands to tens of thousands of frames over minutes, while the structural loop of stage, objective and sample holder drifts tens of nanometres with temperature, far beyond the localization precision. Lateral drift is corrected in two ways: non-bleaching gold nanoparticles or multicolour beads in the sample serve as fiducials tracked frame by frame, or the localizations are cut into time segments and cross-correlated. Axially, an infrared beam reflected from the coverslip interface provides an active focus lock; without it defocus not only fattens the PSF but shifts 3D heights wholesale. STED and SIM frames are faster, but multicolour or long acquisitions still need a drift record.
units.model: 結構迴路 50 mm、鋁 CTE 23 ppm/K、溫度每分鐘變 0.02 K：漂移 ≈ 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min；20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s 累積約 77 nm，是 4.8 nm 定位精度的 16 倍。以每幀 5×10⁴ 光子的金粒子為基準，σ_f ≈ 94/√50000 ≈ 0.42 nm；若改用互相關、每 1000 幀一段，只有 20 個取樣點，段內 3.8 nm 的漂移只能靠內插。~A 50 mm structural loop in aluminium (CTE 23 ppm/K) with temperature changing 0.02 K per minute drifts about 50×10⁻³×23×10⁻⁶×0.02 = 23 nm/min; 20 000 frames at 10 ms take 200 s and accumulate about 77 nm, sixteen times the 4.8 nm precision. A gold fiducial giving 5×10⁴ photons per frame has σ_f ≈ 94/√50000 ≈ 0.42 nm; cross-correlation in 1000-frame segments yields only 20 samples, and the 3.8 nm of drift within each segment must be interpolated.
units.verify: 在固定的螢光珠樣品上不做校正連續取像 10 分鐘，量 x、y、z 漂移對時間的曲線；開啟基準點校正後重複，殘差標準差應小於 1.5 nm；比較焦距鎖定開與關時的 z 漂移，並在 3D 模式下以已知高度的珠確認高度偏移。~Image a fixed bead sample for 10 minutes without correction and plot x, y and z drift against time; repeat with fiducial correction on, expecting a residual standard deviation below 1.5 nm; compare z drift with the focus lock on and off, and in 3D mode confirm height offsets with beads at known heights.
units.failure: 選用的基準螢光珠在長時間照射下逐漸漂白，後段幀的基準定位精度變差，校正把雜訊注入整個資料集，影像後半段變模糊；若不檢查基準點光子數隨時間的變化，會誤判為樣品品質問題。~The fiducial beads chosen slowly bleach under long illumination, their localization precision degrades in late frames, the correction injects noise into the whole dataset and the second half of the image blurs; without checking fiducial photon counts over time this is misdiagnosed as poor sample quality.
units.misconception: 載物台夠穩固就不需要漂移校正。~A rigid enough stage makes drift correction unnecessary.

units.anchor: 解析度預算與 FRC 曲線~Resolution budget and FRC curve
units.title: 解析度誤差預算與奈奎斯特取樣~Resolution error budget and Nyquist sampling
units.mechanism: 定位影像的實際解析度是多個獨立誤差的平方和：定位精度、漂移校正殘差、標記連結誤差與雙色配準誤差，並受標記密度的奈奎斯特極限約束，單看定位精度會嚴重高估解析度。傅立葉環相關（FRC）把資料分成兩半各自重建，比較兩者在各空間頻率的相關性，以 1/7 閾值給出可與預算比較的解析度；若 FRC 遠差於預算，表示有未列入的誤差來源，例如同一分子重複計數或漂移殘差。~The real resolution of a localization image is the root-sum-square of independent errors, namely localization precision, drift-correction residual, label linkage error and two-colour registration error, and it is further bounded by the Nyquist limit of labeling density, so localization precision alone grossly overstates resolution. Fourier ring correlation (FRC) splits the data into two halves, reconstructs each and compares their correlation at every spatial frequency, giving at the 1/7 threshold a resolution comparable with the budget; an FRC far worse than the budget reveals an unlisted error such as repeated counting of one molecule or drift residual.
units.model: σ_定位 4.8 nm、漂移殘差 1.5 nm、一抗加二抗連結誤差 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm：σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm；改用奈米抗體（連結 2 nm）σ ≈ 6.2 nm，FWHM ≈ 15 nm。23 nm 解析度需標記間距 ≤ 11.7 nm，即 ≥ 7.3×10³ 個/µm²；若實際只有 2000 個/µm²，平均間距 22 nm，奈奎斯特解析度僅 45 nm，瓶頸變成標記而非光學。~With 4.8 nm localization, 1.5 nm drift residual, 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration, σ = √(4.8² + 1.5² + 8² + 3²) ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM = 2.355σ ≈ 23 nm; nanobodies with 2 nm linkage give σ ≈ 6.2 nm and FWHM ≈ 15 nm. A 23 nm resolution needs label spacing ≤ 11.7 nm, at least 7.3×10³ labels/µm²; with only 2000 labels/µm² the mean spacing is 22 nm and the Nyquist resolution only 45 nm, so labeling rather than optics becomes the bottleneck.
units.verify: 把定位資料依奇偶幀分成兩半，計算 FRC 曲線與 1/7 閾值的交點；與預算 FWHM 比較，差距超過 30% 時逐項檢查重複計數、漂移與配準；在已知形狀的結構上量標記密度並換算奈奎斯特解析度；把預算表、FRC 與密度一起寫入報告。~Split the localizations into odd and even frames, compute the FRC curve and its crossing of the 1/7 threshold; compare with the budget FWHM and, if they differ by more than 30%, check repeated counting, drift and registration in turn; measure labeling density on a structure of known shape and convert it to a Nyquist resolution; report the budget table, FRC and density together.
units.failure: 論文宣稱 10 nm 解析度，依據只是定位精度的中位數；實際標記密度每平方微米約 300 個，奈奎斯特解析度約 115 nm，所謂的奈米結構是稀疏取樣下的隨機點群，後續研究無法重現。~A paper claims 10 nm resolution based only on median localization precision; the actual labeling density is about 300 per square micrometre, a Nyquist resolution near 115 nm, so the reported nanostructures are random point clusters from sparse sampling and later studies cannot reproduce them.
units.misconception: 定位精度就是超解析影像的解析度。~Localization precision equals the resolution of the super-resolution image.

units.anchor: 技術選擇與時間解析度~Technique choice and temporal resolution
units.title: 技術選擇、時間解析度與光劑量整合~Technique selection, temporal resolution and light-dose integration
units.mechanism: 三種超解析方法在系統層級的取捨不同：SIM 用低強度寬場照明、只需數張原始影像，最適合活細胞動態，但解析度只到約兩倍；STED 是點掃描，可直接看到結果，但視野越大越慢，損耗光強度高；單分子定位解析度最高，卻需要數萬幀、特殊緩衝液與通常固定的樣品。整合時要把生物問題的時間尺度、結構尺寸與樣品可承受的光劑量放在同一張表上比較，再決定照明、偵測、焦距鎖定與重建軟體的組合；在同一平台整合多種模式時，共用的物鏡與偵測器必須同時滿足各模式。~The three methods trade differently at system level: SIM uses low-intensity widefield illumination and only a handful of raw frames, best for live-cell dynamics but limited to about twofold; STED scans a point and shows results directly, but slows with field size and uses intense depletion light; single-molecule localization gives the highest resolution but needs tens of thousands of frames, special buffers and usually fixed samples. Integration puts the biological time scale, structure size and tolerable light dose in one table, then chooses the combination of illumination, detection, focus lock and reconstruction software; when one platform hosts several modes, the shared objective and detectors must satisfy all of them.
units.model: SIM 2D 需 3 角度 × 3 相位 = 9 張，每張 10 ms 共 90 ms（約 11 Hz）；STORM 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s；STED 5×5 µm 以 20 nm 像素、每點 10 µs 共 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s。以 1 µm/s 移動的囊泡為例：SIM 一張期間移動 90 nm，與其解析度相當；STED 單張期間移動 625 nm，造成形變；STORM 期間移動 200 µm，完全不可行。典型照射強度量級：SIM 約 10 到 100 W/cm²，dSTORM 約 1 到 10 kW/cm²，STED 損耗光峰值更高。~2D SIM needs 3 angles × 3 phases = 9 frames, 90 ms at 10 ms each (about 11 Hz); STORM takes 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s; STED over 5×5 µm with 20 nm pixels and 10 µs dwell takes 250×250×10 µs = 0.625 s. For a vesicle moving at 1 µm/s, it moves 90 nm during one SIM image, comparable to SIM resolution, 625 nm during one STED frame, causing distortion, and 200 µm during STORM, which is hopeless. Typical intensity orders: SIM about 10 to 100 W/cm², dSTORM about 1 to 10 kW/cm², STED depletion peaks higher still.
units.verify: 對每個候選技術以同一種活細胞樣品做光毒性測試，例如粒線體形態或細胞分裂延遲對總劑量的曲線；以移動中的標準樣品量運動造成的影像形變；把量得的時間解析度、可承受劑量與解析度放入決策表，與生物問題的需求逐項比對。~For each candidate technique run a phototoxicity test on the same live-cell sample, such as mitochondrial morphology or cell-division delay versus total dose; measure motion-induced distortion on a moving reference sample; enter the measured temporal resolution, tolerable dose and resolution into a decision table and check each against the needs of the biological question.
units.failure: 以 STORM 研究活細胞中快速移動的膜蛋白聚集，200 秒取像期間分子早已擴散，重建出的聚集體其實是運動軌跡的疊加；改用 SIM 或單粒子追蹤才是正確的工具選擇。~STORM is used to study fast-moving membrane-protein clusters in live cells; the molecules diffuse far during the 200 s acquisition and the reconstructed clusters are superimposed trajectories, when SIM or single-particle tracking was the right tool.
units.misconception: 解析度最高的技術永遠是最好的選擇。~The highest-resolution technique is always the best choice.

units.anchor: DNA 摺紙奈米尺與核孔標準~DNA-origami rulers and nuclear-pore standards
units.title: 標準樣品驗收與工程交接~Reference-sample acceptance and engineering handoff
units.mechanism: 超解析系統的驗收要用已知幾何的標準樣品，把預算的每一項變成可量的數字：DNA 摺紙奈米尺以設計好的固定間距（例如 40 nm 或 20 nm）驗證解析度與尺度；核孔複合體的八重對稱環提供細胞內的天然標準，同時檢驗標記效率；多色螢光珠驗證雙色配準；長時間珠樣品驗證漂移校正；SIM 以重建影像的傅立葉譜與調制深度驗證條紋參數。交接紀錄要包含各雷射的功率密度、緩衝液配方批次與效期、相機逐像素校正檔、配準矩陣與 FRC 結果，因為任何一項改變都會讓同一個數字代表不同的品質。~Super-resolution acceptance uses reference samples of known geometry to turn every budget item into a measurable number: DNA-origami nanorulers with designed spacings such as 40 nm or 20 nm verify resolution and scale; the eightfold-symmetric ring of the nuclear pore complex offers a natural in-cell standard that also tests labeling efficiency; multicolour beads verify two-colour registration; long bead acquisitions verify drift correction; and SIM fringe parameters are verified from the Fourier spectrum and modulation depth of reconstructions. The handoff must hold each laser's power density, buffer recipe batch and shelf life, per-pixel camera calibration, registration matrices and FRC results, because a change in any of them makes the same number mean a different quality.
units.model: 染料直接連在摺紙上，連結誤差近零，σ = √(4.8² + 1.5²) ≈ 5.0 nm，兩點 FWHM 約 11.9 nm，40 nm 與 20 nm 奈米尺都應清楚分開；40 nm 尺量得 39.2 ± 2.1 nm（n = 50），尺度偏差 −2%，在 ±3% 允收內。其他門檻：雙色配準殘差 ≤ 3 nm、漂移校正殘差 ≤ 1.5 nm、FRC 解析度與預算 FWHM 23 nm 相差 ≤ 30%（例如量得 28 nm）。~With dyes attached directly to the origami the linkage error is near zero, σ = √(4.8² + 1.5²) ≈ 5.0 nm and the two-point FWHM about 11.9 nm, so both 40 nm and 20 nm rulers should separate cleanly; the 40 nm ruler measures 39.2 ± 2.1 nm (n = 50), a −2% scale deviation within a ±3% allowance. Other thresholds: two-colour registration residual ≤ 3 nm, drift-correction residual ≤ 1.5 nm, and FRC resolution within 30% of the 23 nm budget FWHM (for example 28 nm measured).
units.verify: 依固定順序：熱平衡與焦距鎖定；相機暗場與增益校正；多色珠配準；DNA 摺紙奈米尺取像並統計間距分布；核孔樣品統計環直徑與每環定位數；以奇偶幀分半計算 FRC；所有結果與預算並列填表，超出允收者記錄原因與處置。~In a fixed order: thermal settling and focus lock; camera dark and gain calibration; multicolour bead registration; imaging DNA-origami rulers and compiling the spacing distribution; compiling ring diameter and localizations per ring on nuclear pores; FRC from odd-even halves; tabulate every result beside the budget and record cause and disposition for anything outside the allowance.
units.failure: 驗收只看漂亮的微管影像而沒有量奈米尺，放大率校正錯 5% 未被發現，之後所有距離量測都系統性偏差，包括已發表的蛋白間距；交接紀錄也缺少緩衝液批次，問題發生後無法判斷是光學還是化學造成。~Acceptance looked only at attractive microtubule images and never measured a nanoruler, so a 5% magnification error went unnoticed and every later distance, including published protein spacings, carries a systematic bias; the handoff also lacked buffer batch records, so when problems arise nobody can tell whether optics or chemistry is to blame.
units.misconception: 影像看起來夠清晰，尺度與解析度就一定正確。~If images look sharp, scale and resolution must be correct.

example: dSTORM 預算練習：λ = 670 nm、NA = 1.49，PSF 標準差 s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm，樣品端像素 100 nm，每次閃爍 N = 1000 光子。TIRF 背景 b = 3 時 Thompson 精度 σ ≈ 3.4 nm，EMCCD 過量雜訊乘 √2 得 4.8 nm。取 20 000 幀 × 10 ms = 200 s，23 nm/min 的漂移累積 77 nm，以金粒子校正後殘差 1.5 nm。一抗加二抗連結 8 nm、雙色配準 3 nm，總 σ ≈ 9.9 nm，FWHM ≈ 23 nm。此解析度需標記 ≥ 7.3×10³ 個/µm²，每個 0.0625 µm² 繞射面積約 456 個標記，佔空比須 ≤ 2.2×10⁻³；染料佔空比 10⁻³ 時約 3000 幀可讓 95% 標記至少亮一次。若改用 STED 達到同樣 23 nm，需 I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~dSTORM budget exercise: λ = 670 nm and NA = 1.49 give a PSF standard deviation s ≈ 0.21λ/NA ≈ 94 nm, with 100 nm sample-side pixels and N = 1000 photons per blink. With TIRF background b = 3 the Thompson precision is σ ≈ 3.4 nm, and EMCCD excess noise multiplies it by √2 to 4.8 nm. Acquiring 20 000 frames × 10 ms = 200 s, a drift of 23 nm/min accumulates 77 nm, corrected with gold fiducials to a 1.5 nm residual. With 8 nm primary-plus-secondary linkage and 3 nm two-colour registration the total σ ≈ 9.9 nm and FWHM ≈ 23 nm. That resolution needs ≥ 7.3×10³ labels/µm², about 456 labels per 0.0625 µm² diffraction area, so the duty cycle must be ≤ 2.2×10⁻³; with a dye duty cycle of 10⁻³ about 3000 frames let 95% of labels light at least once. Reaching the same 23 nm with STED would need I/I_sat = (229/23)² − 1 ≈ 98. Values are teaching assumptions, not any instrument's specification.
history: 1873 年 Ernst Abbe 提出光學顯微鏡的解析度約為半個波長、約 0.2 µm 的極限。1994 年 Stefan Hell 與 Wichmann 提出受激發射損耗（STED）的構想，2000 年前後以實驗證明；同年 Mats Gustafsson 發表結構照明顯微鏡，把寬場解析度提高約兩倍；1989 年 W. E. Moerner 首次偵測單一分子的光吸收，為單分子方法奠基，2006 年 Betzig 與 Hess 的 PALM、莊小威團隊的 STORM 與 Hess 團隊的 FPALM 幾乎同時發表。2014 年 Betzig、Hell 與 Moerner 因超解析螢光顯微術獲諾貝爾化學獎。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。~In 1873 Ernst Abbe set the resolution limit of optical microscopes at about half a wavelength, roughly 0.2 µm. In 1994 Stefan Hell and Wichmann proposed stimulated emission depletion (STED), demonstrated experimentally around 2000; in the same year Mats Gustafsson published structured illumination microscopy, roughly doubling widefield resolution. In 1989 W. E. Moerner first detected the optical absorption of a single molecule, laying the groundwork for single-molecule methods, and in 2006 PALM by Betzig and Hess, STORM by Xiaowei Zhuang's group and FPALM by Hess's group appeared almost simultaneously. In 2014 Betzig, Hell and Moerner received the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for super-resolved fluorescence microscopy. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.
